code.text: CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia (low arterial oxygen saturation and pO2), profound acidemia (very low arterial pH), and pancytopenia (low leukocytes, neutrophils, lymphocytes, and platelets) with monocytosis, basophilia, and eosinophilia. These findings are highly concerning for a serious underlying condition such as severe infection/sepsis, bone marrow dysfunction, or hematologic disease. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
